## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounded. The cited theorem gives integral generation and irredundancy of the lower family.
- claim-2: Correctly grounded and stronger than mere irredundancy. For excess degrees \(N=1,\ldots,6\), it can exclude every nonzero integral relation among same-degree lower generators modulo \(A_+J\). The degree-\(9\) case \(N=0\) still requires the separate observation \((A_+J)_9=0\).
- claim-3: Correctly grounded for generation and conjugacy. Given \(\omega(J)=J\) and \(\omega(A_+)=A_+\), it supports the right-family basis argument.
- claim-4: Essentially supported by the strategy, but the lifting argument should explicitly expand every homogeneous element of \(A_+J\) through the lower generators and verify the no-syzygy hypotheses for \(N=1,\ldots,6\). The omitted \(N=0\) argument must also be supplied.
- claim-5: Not established. The antipode identity at [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735] does not directly state
  \[
  [R_{\rho'}]=(-1)^{|\rho|}[L_\rho].
  \]
  The strategy neither identifies the specialization of that identity nor proves that all other terms lie in \(A_+J\). Consequently the displayed ten reductions and the diagonal transition matrix currently lack exact quotient witnesses.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] For every \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), exhibit an explicit integral identity
  \[
  R_{\rho'}-(-1)^{|\rho|}L_\rho
  =\sum_k a_k\,h_{t_k}\bar s_{\lambda_k},
  \qquad 1\le t_k\le5,\quad \bar s_{\lambda_k}\in J,
  \]
  or derive these identities rigorously from the antipode formula while identifying the two surviving terms and proving every discarded term belongs to \(A_+J\).
- [computation] Using the complete Pieri relation matrices in degrees \(9,\ldots,15\), provide exact integral quotient-coordinate witnesses for all lower and right classes and verify that the right-coordinate columns in the ordered lower bases are
  \[
  [1],\ [-1],\ I_2,\ -I_2,\ I_2,\ [-1],\ [1].
  \]

## Required revisions
- Define \(J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda\), list both graded families, and handle degree \(9\) separately.
- Make the lower-family lifting/no-syzygy argument explicit in every relevant degree.
- Supply exact membership witnesses in \(A_+J\) for the claimed transition congruences.
- State that the requested target is **not yet established**: the basis portion is nearly complete, but the explicit unimodular transition remains unsupported.
